shape.text: A programmatic API key has a Public Key and a Private Key, which serve as a username and a password; the public key is specified as exactly 8 characters.
The private key has a documented prefix, alphabet, length or separator grammar.

unresolved.reason: No page read states one: the specification shows a single example, and a provider example does not prove a universal rule.

issuance.text: The private key is returned unredacted when the key is first created; later responses return a redacted private key.
A programmatic API key is declared under an HTTP digest security scheme, in which the credential is hashed with a short-lived nonce, and not under a bearer scheme.

lifecycle.text: MongoDB describes programmatic API keys as a legacy method of authenticating to the Atlas Administration API, with service accounts as the recommended method.

collisions.text: The 24-character hexadecimal object identifier that the API returns for a key is documented as an identifier of the key, not as part of the credential.

openQuestions.text: Programmatic API private keys were issued in more than one form over time.

unresolved.reason: No page read gives a history, and no archive snapshot was available to pin a historical claim.
